local StringCharset = {}
local NumberCharset = {}

QBCore.Shared.StarterItems = {
    ['phone'] = { amount = 1, item = 'phone' },
    ['id_card'] = { amount = 1, item = 'id_card' },
    ['driver_license'] = { amount = 1, item = 'driver_license' },
}

for i = 48, 57 do NumberCharset[#NumberCharset + 1] = string.char(i) end
for i = 65, 90 do StringCharset[#StringCharset + 1] = string.char(i) end
for i = 97, 122 do StringCharset[#StringCharset + 1] = string.char(i) end

function QBCore.Shared.RandomStr(length)
    if length <= 0 then return '' end
    return QBCore.Shared.RandomStr(length - 1) .. StringCharset[math.random(1, #StringCharset)]
end

function QBCore.Shared.RandomInt(length)
    if length <= 0 then return '' end
    return QBCore.Shared.RandomInt(length - 1) .. NumberCharset[math.random(1, #NumberCharset)]
end

function QBCore.Shared.SplitStr(str, delimiter)
    local result = {}
    local from = 1
    local delim_from, delim_to = string.find(str, delimiter, from)
    while delim_from do
        result[#result + 1] = string.sub(str, from, delim_from - 1)
        from = delim_to + 1
        delim_from, delim_to = string.find(str, delimiter, from)
    end
    result[#result + 1] = string.sub(str, from)
    return result
end

function QBCore.Shared.Trim(value)
    if not value then return nil end
    return (string.gsub(value, '^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1'))
end

function QBCore.Shared.FirstToUpper(value)
    if not value then return nil end
    return (value:gsub('^%l', string.upper))
end

function QBCore.Shared.Round(value, numDecimalPlaces)
    if not numDecimalPlaces then return math.floor(value + 0.5) end
    local power = 10 ^ numDecimalPlaces
    return math.floor((value * power) + 0.5) / (power)
end

function QBCore.Shared.ChangeVehicleExtra(vehicle, extra, enable)
    if DoesExtraExist(vehicle, extra) then
        if enable then
            SetVehicleExtra(vehicle, extra, false)
            if not IsVehicleExtraTurnedOn(vehicle, extra) then
                QBCore.Shared.ChangeVehicleExtra(vehicle, extra, enable)
            end
        else
            SetVehicleExtra(vehicle, extra, true)
            if IsVehicleExtraTurnedOn(vehicle, extra) then
                QBCore.Shared.ChangeVehicleExtra(vehicle, extra, enable)
            end
        end
    end
end

function QBCore.Shared.IsFunction(value)
    if type(value) == 'table' then
        return value.__cfx_functionReference ~= nil and type(value.__cfx_functionReference) == 'string'
    end

    return type(value) == 'function'
end

function QBCore.Shared.SetDefaultVehicleExtras(vehicle, config)
    for i = 1, 20 do
        if DoesExtraExist(vehicle, i) then
            SetVehicleExtra(vehicle, i, 1)
        end
    end

    for id, enabled in pairs(config) do
        if type(enabled) ~= 'boolean' then
            enabled = true
        end

        QBCore.Shared.ChangeVehicleExtra(vehicle, tonumber(id), enabled)
    end
end

--- @class Locale
Locale = {}
Locale.__index = Locale

local function translateKey(phrase, subs)
    if type(phrase) ~= 'string' then
        error('TypeError: translateKey function expects arg #1 to be a string')
    end

    -- Substituions
    if not subs then
        return phrase
    end

    -- We should be escaping gsub just in case of any
    -- shenanigans with nested template patterns or injection

    -- Create and copy our return string
    local result = phrase

    -- Initial Scan over result looking for substituions
    for k, v in pairs(subs) do
        local templateToFind = '%%{' .. k .. '}'
        result = result:gsub(templateToFind, tostring(v)) -- string to allow all types
    end

    return result
end

--- Constructor function for a new Locale class instance
--- @param opts table<string, any> - Constructor opts param
--- @return Locale
function Locale.new(_, opts)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Locale)

    self.fallback = opts.fallbackLang and Locale:new({
        warnOnMissing = false,
        phrases = opts.fallbackLang.phrases,
    }) or false

    self.warnOnMissing = type(opts.warnOnMissing) ~= 'boolean' and true or opts.warnOnMissing

    self.phrases = {}
    self:extend(opts.phrases or {})

    return self
end

--- Method for extending an instances phrases map. This is also, used
--- internally for initial population of phrases field.
--- @param phrases table<string, string> - Table of phrase definitions
--- @param prefix string | nil - Optional prefix used for recursive calls
--- @return nil
function Locale:extend(phrases, prefix)
    for key, phrase in pairs(phrases) do
        local prefixKey = prefix and ('%s.%s'):format(prefix, key) or key
        -- If this is a nested table, we need to go reeeeeeeeeeeecursive
        if type(phrase) == 'table' then
            self:extend(phrase, prefixKey)
        else
            self.phrases[prefixKey] = phrase
        end
    end
end

--- Clear locale instance phrases
--- Might be useful for memory management of large phrase maps.
--- @return nil
function Locale:clear()
    self.phrases = {}
end

--- Clears all phrases and replaces it with the passed phrases table
--- @param phrases table<string, any>
function Locale:replace(phrases)
    phrases = phrases or {}
    self:clear()
    self:extend(phrases)
end

--- Gets & Sets a locale depending on if an argument is passed
--- @param newLocale string - Optional new locale to set
--- @return string
function Locale:locale(newLocale)
    if (newLocale) then
        self.currentLocale = newLocale
    end
    return self.currentLocale
end

--- Primary translation method for a phrase of given key
--- @param key string - The phrase key to target
--- @param subs table<string, any> | nil
--- @return string
function Locale:t(key, subs)
    local phrase, result
    subs = subs or {}

    -- See if the passed key resolves to a valid phrase string
    if type(self.phrases[key]) == 'string' then
        phrase = self.phrases[key]
        -- At this point we know whether the phrase does not exist for this key
    else
        if self.warnOnMissing then
            print(('^3Warning: Missing phrase for key: "%s"^0'):format(key))
        end
        if self.fallback then
            return self.fallback:t(key, subs)
        end
        result = key
    end

    if type(phrase) == 'string' then
        result = translateKey(phrase, subs)
    end

    return result
end

--- Check if a phrase key has already been defined within the Locale instance phrase maps.
--- @return boolean
function Locale:has(key)
    return self.phrases[key] ~= nil
end

--- Will remove phrase keys from a Locale instance, using recursion/
--- @param phraseTarget string | table
--- @param prefix string
function Locale:delete(phraseTarget, prefix)
    -- If the target is a string, we know that this is the end
    -- of nested table tree.
    if type(phraseTarget) == 'string' then
        self.phrases[phraseTarget] = nil
    else
        for key, phrase in pairs(phraseTarget) do
            local prefixKey = prefix and prefix .. '.' .. key or key

            if type(phrase) == 'table' then
                self:delete(phrase, prefixKey)
            else
                self.phrases[prefixKey] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

QBCore.Shared = {}
QBCore.ClientCallbacks = {}
QBCore.ServerCallbacks = {}

--- @param filters ('Config'|'Shared'|'ClientCallbacks'|'ServerCallbacks'|'PlayerData'|'Functions'|'Players'|'PlayersByCitizenId'|'Player_Buckets'|'Entity_Buckets'|'UsableItems'|'Commands')[]?
--- @return table
local function GetCoreObject(filters)
    if not filters then return QBCore end
    local results = {}
    for i = 1, #filters do
        local key = filters[i]
        if QBCore[key] then
            results[key] = QBCore[key]
        end
    end
    return results
end
exports('GetCoreObject', GetCoreObject)

--- @param namespace 'Vehicles' | 'VehicleHashes' | 'Items' | 'Gangs' | 'Jobs' | 'Locations' | 'Weapons' | 'StarterItems'
--- @param item string?
--- @return table?
function GetShared(namespace, item)
    local ns = QBCore.Shared[namespace]
    if not ns then return nil end

    return item and ns[item] or ns
end

exports('GetShared', GetShared)

---@enum Position
local positions = {
    left = 'left-center',
    right = 'right-center',
    top = 'top-center'
}

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
local function hideText()
    lib.hideTextUI()
end

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
---@param text string
---@param position Position
local function drawText(text, position)
    position = positions[position] or position
    lib.showTextUI(text, {
        position = position
    })
end

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
---@param text string
---@param position Position
local function changeText(text, position)
    position = positions[position] or position
    lib.hideTextUI()
    lib.showTextUI(text, {
        position = position
    })
end

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
local function keyPressed()
    CreateThread(function() -- Not sure if a thread is needed but why not eh?
        Wait(500)
        lib.hideTextUI()
    end)
end

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
RegisterNetEvent('qb-core:client:DrawText', function(text, position)
    drawText(text, position)
end)

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
RegisterNetEvent('qb-core:client:ChangeText', function(text, position)
    changeText(text, position)
end)

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
RegisterNetEvent('qb-core:client:HideText', function()
    lib.hideTextUI()
end)

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
RegisterNetEvent('qb-core:client:KeyPressed', function()
    keyPressed()
end)

local createQbExport = require 'bridge.qb.shared.export-function'

---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
createQbExport('DrawText', drawText)
---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
createQbExport('ChangeText', changeText)
---@deprecated use ox_lib showTextUI calls directly
createQbExport('HideText', hideText)

local config = require 'config.client'

-- Trigger Command
--- @deprecated
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Command:CallCommand', function(command)
    ExecuteCommand(command)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:VehicleInfo', function(info)
    local vehicle = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(info.netId)
    local plate = qbx.getVehiclePlate(vehicle)
    local hasKeys = config.hasKeys(plate, vehicle)

    local data = {
        vehicle = vehicle,
        seat = info.seat,
        name = info.modelName,
        plate = plate,
        driver = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1),
        inseat = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, info.seat),
        haskeys = hasKeys
    }

    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Client:'..info.event..'Vehicle', data)
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('hunger', ('player:%s'):format(cache.serverId), function(_, _, value)
    TriggerEvent('hud:client:UpdateNeeds', value, LocalPlayer.state.thirst)
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('thirst', ('player:%s'):format(cache.serverId), function(_, _, value)
    TriggerEvent('hud:client:UpdateNeeds', LocalPlayer.state.hunger, value)
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('stress', ('player:%s'):format(cache.serverId), function(_, _, value)
    TriggerEvent('hud:client:UpdateStress', value)
end)

---@deprecated use qbx.spawnVehicle from modules/lib.lua on the server
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Command:SpawnVehicle', function(vehName)
    local hash = type(vehName) == 'number' and vehName or type(vehName) == 'string' and joaat(vehName)
    if not hash or not IsModelInCdimage(hash) then return end
    lib.requestModel(hash)

    if IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, false) then
        qbx.deleteVehicle(GetVehiclePedIsUsing(cache.ped))
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local vehicle = CreateVehicle(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, GetEntityHeading(cache.ped), true, false)
    TaskWarpPedIntoVehicle(cache.ped, vehicle, -1)
    SetVehicleFuelLevel(vehicle, 100.0)
    SetVehicleDirtLevel(vehicle, 0.0)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
    TriggerEvent('vehiclekeys:client:SetOwner', qbx.getVehiclePlate(vehicle))
end)

---@deprecated use qbx.deleteVehicle from modules/lib.lua
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Command:DeleteVehicle', function()
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsUsing(cache.ped)
    if vehicle ~= 0 then
        qbx.deleteVehicle(vehicle)
        return
    end

    local vehicles = lib.getNearbyVehicles(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped), 5.0, true)
    for i = 1, #vehicles do
        qbx.deleteVehicle(vehicles[i].vehicle)
    end
end)

---@deprecated qbx_core applies PvP from GlobalState.PVPEnabled
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:PvpHasToggled', function(pvpState)
    SetCanAttackFriendly(cache.ped, pvpState, false)
    NetworkSetFriendlyFireOption(pvpState)
end)

---@deprecated qbx_core sends player data updates without a client request
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Player:UpdatePlayerData', function()
    TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:UpdatePlayer')
end)

---@deprecated
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:UseItem', function(item)
    lib.print.warn(('%s triggered QBCore:Client:UseItem by ID %s with the following data. This event is deprecated due to exploitation, and will be removed soon. Check qb-inventory for the right use on this event.'):format(GetInvokingResource(), cache.serverId))
    lib.print.warn(item)
end)

---@deprecated use the 'me' player state bag
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Command:ShowMe3D', function(senderId, msg)
    local sender = GetPlayerFromServerId(senderId)
    if sender == -1 or not msg then return end

    CreateThread(function()
        local displayTime = GetGameTimer() + 5000
        while displayTime > GetGameTimer() do
            qbx.drawText3d({ text = tostring(msg), coords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(sender)) })
            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end)

---@param itemName any
---@return number
local function getItemCount(itemName)
    if type(itemName) ~= 'string' then return 0 end
    itemName = itemName:lower()
    if itemName:sub(1, 7) == 'weapon_' then itemName = itemName:upper() end
    return exports.ox_inventory:GetItemCount(itemName) or 0
end

---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_inventory/Functions/Client#getitemcount
---@param items string | string[] | table<string, number>
---@param amount? number
---@return boolean
functions.HasItem = function(items, amount)
    if type(items) ~= 'table' then
        return getItemCount(items) >= (amount or 1)
    end

    if next(items) == nil then return false end

    local isArray = table.type(items) == 'array'
    for key, value in pairs(items) do
        local required = amount or (not isArray and tonumber(value)) or 1
        if getItemCount(isArray and value or key) < required then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

---@deprecated use the GetHeadingFromVector_2d and SetEntityHeading natives directly
---@param entity number
---@param timeout number
---@param speed number
---@return string? error
functions.LookAtEntity = function(entity, timeout, speed)
    local invoked = GetInvokingResource() or cache.resource
    if type(entity) ~= 'number' then
        return invoked .. ' :^1  Entity must be a number'
    end
    if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        return invoked .. ' :^1  Entity does not exist'
    end
    if type(speed) ~= 'number' then
        return invoked .. ' :^1  Speed must be a number'
    end
    speed = math.min(speed, 5.0)
    timeout = math.min(timeout or 5000, 5000)

    local ped = cache.ped
    local playerPos = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local targetPos = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local targetHeading = GetHeadingFromVector_2d(targetPos.x - playerPos.x, targetPos.y - playerPos.y)
    local endTime = GetGameTimer() + timeout
    while true do
        local currentHeading = GetEntityHeading(ped)
        local diff = targetHeading - currentHeading
        if math.abs(diff) < 2 then break end
        if diff < -180 then
            diff += 360
        elseif diff > 180 then
            diff -= 360
        end
        local turnSpeed = speed + (2.5 - speed) * (1 - math.abs(diff) / 180)
        SetEntityHeading(ped, diff > 0 and currentHeading + turnSpeed or currentHeading - turnSpeed)
        Wait(0)
        if GetGameTimer() > endTime then break end
    end
    SetEntityHeading(ped, targetHeading)
end

---@deprecated use lib.playAnim from ox_lib
---@param animDict string
---@param animName string
---@param upperbodyOnly? boolean
---@param duration? number ms, -1 or nil loops the animation
---@return number | string durationOrError animation length in seconds once it has played, or an error message
functions.PlayAnim = function(animDict, animName, upperbodyOnly, duration)
    local invoked = GetInvokingResource() or cache.resource
    if type(animDict) ~= 'string' or type(animName) ~= 'string' then
        return invoked .. ' :^1  Wrong type for animDict or animName'
    end
    if not DoesAnimDictExist(animDict) then
        return invoked .. ' :^1  Animation dictionary does not exist'
    end
    if not pcall(lib.requestAnimDict, animDict, 5000) then
        return invoked .. ' :^1  Animation dictionary failed to load'
    end

    local runTime = duration or -1
    local flags = runTime == -1 and 49 or upperbodyOnly and 16 or 0
    TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, animDict, animName, 8.0, 8.0, runTime, flags, 0.0, true, true, true)
    Wait(10)
    local animDuration = GetAnimDuration(animDict, animName)
    if animDuration == 0 then
        return invoked .. ' :^1  Animation does not exist'
    end

    local fullDuration = animDuration * 1000
    Wait(duration and math.min(duration, fullDuration) or fullDuration)
    RemoveAnimDict(animDict)
    return animDuration
end

---@alias QbProgressProp {model: string, bone?: number, coords?: vector3|table, rotation?: vector3|table}

---@param value? vector3|table
---@return vector3
local function toVec3(value)
    return value and vec3(value.x, value.y, value.z) or vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
end

---@param prop? QbProgressProp
---@return ProgressPropProps?
local function toProgressProp(prop)
    if not prop?.model then return end
    return {
        model = prop.model,
        bone = prop.bone,
        pos = toVec3(prop.coords),
        rot = toVec3(prop.rotation),
    }
end

---@param animation? {animDict?: string, anim?: string, flags?: integer, task?: string}
---@return table?
local function toProgressAnim(animation)
    if not animation then return end
    if animation.task then
        return { scenario = animation.task }
    end
    if animation.animDict and animation.anim then
        return {
            dict = animation.animDict,
            clip = animation.anim,
            flag = animation.flags or 1,
            blendIn = 3.0,
            blendOut = 3.0,
        }
    end
end

local isProgressbarRunning = false

---Returns immediately like QBCore's; onFinish or onCancel runs when the bar ends.
---@deprecated use lib.progressBar from ox_lib
---@param label string
---@param duration integer ms
---@param useWhileDead boolean
---@param canCancel boolean
---@param disableControls? {disableMovement: boolean, disableCarMovement: boolean, disableCombat: boolean, disableMouse: boolean}
---@param animation? {animDict?: string, anim?: string, flags?: integer, task?: string}
---@param prop? QbProgressProp
---@param propTwo? QbProgressProp
---@param onFinish? fun()
---@param onCancel? fun()
function functions.Progressbar(_, label, duration, useWhileDead, canCancel, disableControls, animation, prop, propTwo, onFinish, onCancel)
    if isProgressbarRunning or lib.progressActive() then return end
    if not useWhileDead and IsEntityDead(cache.ped) then return end

    local props = {}
    props[#props + 1] = toProgressProp(prop)
    props[#props + 1] = toProgressProp(propTwo)

    isProgressbarRunning = true
    CreateThread(function()
        local ok, completed = pcall(lib.progressBar, {
            duration = duration,
            label = label,
            useWhileDead = useWhileDead,
            allowRagdoll = true,
            allowCuffed = true,
            allowFalling = true,
            allowSwimming = true,
            canCancel = canCancel,
            disable = disableControls and {
                move = disableControls.disableMovement,
                car = disableControls.disableCarMovement,
                combat = disableControls.disableCombat,
                mouse = disableControls.disableMouse,
            },
            anim = toProgressAnim(animation),
            prop = props[1] and props,
        })
        isProgressbarRunning = false

        if not ok then
            lib.print.error(completed)
        end

        if ok and completed then
            if onFinish then
                onFinish()
            end
        elseif onCancel then
            onCancel()
        end
    end)
end

---@param pool string
---@param ignoreList? integer[]
---@return integer[]
local function getEntities(pool, ignoreList) -- luacheck: ignore
    ignoreList = ignoreList or {}
    local ents = GetGamePool(pool)
    local entities = {}
    local ignoreMap = {}
    for i = 1, #ignoreList do
        ignoreMap[ignoreList[i]] = true
    end

    for i = 1, #ents do
        local entity = ents[i]
        if not ignoreMap[entity] then
            entities[#entities + 1] = entity
        end
    end
    return entities
end

---@param entities integer[]
---@param coords vector3? if unset uses player coords
---@return integer closestObj or -1
---@return number closestDistance or -1
local function getClosestEntity(entities, coords) -- luacheck: ignore
    coords = toCoords(coords)
    local closestDistance = -1
    local closestEntity = -1
    for i = 1, #entities do
        local entity = entities[i]
        local entityCoords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
        local distance = #(entityCoords - coords)
        if closestDistance == -1 or closestDistance > distance then
            closestEntity = entity
            closestDistance = distance
        end
    end
    return closestEntity, closestDistance
end

functions.GetClosestBone = function(entity, list)
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

    ---@type integer | {id: integer} | {id: integer, type: string, name: string}, vector3, number
    local bone, coords, distance
    for _, element in pairs(list) do
        local boneCoords = GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(entity, element.id or element)
        local boneDistance = #(playerCoords - boneCoords)
        if not coords or distance > boneDistance then
            bone = element
            coords = boneCoords
            distance = boneDistance
        end
    end
    if not bone then
        bone = {id = GetEntityBoneIndexByName(entity, 'bodyshell'), type = 'remains', name = 'bodyshell'}
        coords = GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(entity, bone.id)
        distance = #(coords - playerCoords)
    end
    return bone, coords, distance
end

    local bone = GetPedBoneIndex(ped, boneId)
    lib.requestModel(modelHash)
    local prop = CreateObject(modelHash, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, true, true, false)
    AttachEntityToEntity(prop, ped, bone, x, y, z, xR, yR, zR, true, true, false, true, not vertex and 2 or 0, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(modelHash)
    return prop
end

---@deprecated use qbx.spawnVehicle from modules/lib.lua
---@param model string|number
---@param cb? fun(vehicle: number)
---@param coords? vector4 player position if not specified
---@param isnetworked? boolean defaults to true
---@param teleportInto boolean teleport player to driver seat if true
function functions.SpawnVehicle(model, cb, coords, isnetworked, teleportInto)
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local combinedCoords = vec4(playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z, GetEntityHeading(cache.ped))
    coords = type(coords) == 'table' and vec4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w or combinedCoords.w) or coords or combinedCoords
    model = type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or model
    if not IsModelInCdimage(model) then return end

    isnetworked = isnetworked == nil or isnetworked
    lib.requestModel(model)
    local veh = CreateVehicle(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w, isnetworked, false)
    local netid = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(veh)
    SetVehicleHasBeenOwnedByPlayer(veh, true)
    SetNetworkIdCanMigrate(netid, true)
    SetVehicleNeedsToBeHotwired(veh, false)
    SetVehRadioStation(veh, 'OFF')
    SetVehicleFuelLevel(veh, 100.0)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
    if teleportInto then TaskWarpPedIntoVehicle(cache.ped, veh, -1) end
    if cb then cb(veh) end
end

functions.SpawnClear = function(coords, radius)
    coords = toCoords(coords)
    radius = radius or 5
    local vehicles = GetGamePool('CVehicle')
    local closeVeh = {}
    for i = 1, #vehicles do
        local vehicleCoords = GetEntityCoords(vehicles[i])
        local distance = #(vehicleCoords - coords)
        if distance <= radius then
            closeVeh[#closeVeh + 1] = vehicles[i]
        end
    end
    return #closeVeh == 0
end

function functions.GetVehicleProperties(vehicle)
    local props = lib.getVehicleProperties(vehicle)
    if not props then return end

    local tireHealth = {}
        for i = 0, 3 do
            tireHealth[i] = GetVehicleWheelHealth(vehicle, i)
        end

    local tireBurstState = {}
    local tireBurstCompletely = {}

    for i = 0, 7 do
        local damage = props.tyres[i]
        tireBurstState[i] = damage == 1 or damage == 2
        tireBurstCompletely[i] = damage == 2
    end

    local windowStatus = {}
    for i = 0, 7 do
        windowStatus[i] = IsVehicleWindowIntact(vehicle, i)
    end

    local doorStatus = {}
    for i = 0, 5 do
        doorStatus[i] = IsVehicleDoorDamaged(vehicle, i)
    end

    -- qb properties not in ox
    props.tireHealth = tireHealth
    props.tireBurstState = tireBurstState
    props.tireBurstCompletely = tireBurstCompletely
    props.windowStatus = windowStatus
    props.doorStatus = doorStatus
    props.headlightColor = GetVehicleHeadlightsColour(vehicle)
    props.modKit17 = props.modNitrous
    props.modKit19 = props.modSubwoofer
    props.modKit21 = props.modHydraulics
    props.modKit47 = props.modDoorR
    props.modKit49 = props.modLightbar
    props.liveryRoof = props.modRoofLivery

    if props.modLivery == -1 and GetVehicleLivery(vehicle) ~= 0 then
        props.modLivery = GetVehicleLivery(vehicle)
    end

    return props
end

function functions.SetVehicleProperties(vehicle, props)
    if not props or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return end

    if props.tireHealth and not props.tyres then
        for wheelIndex, health in pairs(props.tireHealth) do
            SetVehicleWheelHealth(vehicle, tonumber(wheelIndex) --[[@as number]], health)
        end
    end
    if props.headlightColor then
        SetVehicleHeadlightsColour(vehicle, props.headlightColor)
    end

    if (props.tireBurstCompletely or props.tireBurstState) and not props.tyres then
        props.tyres = {}
        for i = 0, 7 do
            local completely = props.tireBurstCompletely and (props.tireBurstCompletely[i] or props.tireBurstCompletely[tostring(i)])
            local burst = props.tireBurstState and (props.tireBurstState[i] or props.tireBurstState[tostring(i)])
            props.tyres[i] = completely and 2 or burst and 1 or nil
        end
    end

    local numWindowsDamaged = 0
    if props.windowStatus and not props.windows then
        props.windows = {}
        -- QBCore's getter compares a boolean native to 1, so its saved windowStatus is all false; only trust data with an intact window
        local hasIntactWindow = false
        for _, isIntact in pairs(props.windowStatus) do
            if isIntact then
                hasIntactWindow = true
                break
            end
        end
        if hasIntactWindow then
            for i, isIntact in pairs(props.windowStatus) do
                if not isIntact then
                    numWindowsDamaged += 1
                    props.windows[numWindowsDamaged] = tonumber(i)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local numDoorsDamaged = 0
    if props.doorStatus and not props.doors then
        props.doors = {}
        for i, isDamaged in pairs(props.doorStatus) do
            if isDamaged then
                numDoorsDamaged += 1
                props.doors[numDoorsDamaged] = tonumber(i)
            end
        end
    end

    -- qb properties converted to ox
    props.modNitrous = props.modNitrous or props.modKit17
    props.modSubwoofer = props.modSubwoofer or props.modKit19
    props.modHydraulics = props.modHydraulics or props.modKit21
    props.modDoorR = props.modDoorR or props.modKit47
    props.modLightbar = props.modLightbar or props.modKit49
    props.modRoofLivery = props.modRoofLivery or props.liveryRoof

    -- Adapted from ox_lib with its errors removed so setting properties is best effort: https://github.com/overextended/ox_lib/blob/dda2e0927fec2aeb0f5f12fc88c0f614796c043f/resource/vehicleProperties/client.lua#L288-L647
    -- Copyright (C) 2021-2023 Linden, Luke, and contributors, LGPL-3.0-or-later (see LICENSES/LGPL-3.0-or-later.txt)
    assert(DoesEntityExist(vehicle), ('Unable to set vehicle properties for "%s" (entity does not exist)'):format(vehicle))

    if NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(vehicle) and NetworkGetEntityOwner(vehicle) ~= cache.playerId then
        lib.print.warn('setting vehicle properties on non entity owner client. This may cause certain properties to fail to set. entity:', vehicle)
    end

    local colorPrimary, colorSecondary = GetVehicleColours(vehicle)
    local pearlescentColor, wheelColor = GetVehicleExtraColours(vehicle)

    SetVehicleModKit(vehicle, 0)
    -- SetVehicleAutoRepairDisabled(vehicle, true)

    if props.extras then
        for id, disable in pairs(props.extras) do
            SetVehicleExtra(vehicle, tonumber(id) --[[@as number]], disable == 1 or disable == false)
        end
    end

    if props.plate then

    if props.plateIndex then

    if props.bodyHealth then

functions.StartParticleAtCoord = function(dict, ptName, looped, coords, rot, scale, alpha, color, duration) -- luacheck: ignore
    coords = toCoords(coords)

    lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset(dict)
    UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(dict)
    SetPtfxAssetNextCall(dict)
    local particleHandle
    if looped then
        particleHandle = StartParticleFxLoopedAtCoord(ptName, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, scale or 1.0, false, false, false, false)
        if color then
            SetParticleFxLoopedColour(particleHandle, color.r, color.g, color.b, false)
        end
        SetParticleFxLoopedAlpha(particleHandle, alpha or 10.0)
        if duration then
            Wait(duration)
            StopParticleFxLooped(particleHandle, false)
        end
    else
        SetParticleFxNonLoopedAlpha(alpha or 1.0)
        if color then
            SetParticleFxNonLoopedColour(color.r, color.g, color.b)
        end
        StartParticleFxNonLoopedAtCoord(ptName, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
    end
    return particleHandle
end

functions.StartParticleOnEntity = function(dict, ptName, looped, entity, bone, offset, rot, scale, alpha, color, evolution, duration) -- luacheck: ignore
    lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset(dict)
    UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(dict)
    local particleHandle = nil
    ---@cast bone number
    local pedBoneIndex = bone and GetPedBoneIndex(entity, bone) or 0
    ---@cast bone string
    local nameBoneIndex = bone and GetEntityBoneIndexByName(entity, bone) or 0
    local entityType = GetEntityType(entity)
    local boneID = entityType == 1 and (pedBoneIndex ~= 0 and pedBoneIndex) or (looped and nameBoneIndex ~= 0 and nameBoneIndex)
    if looped then
        if boneID then
            particleHandle = StartParticleFxLoopedOnEntityBone(ptName, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, boneID, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
        else
            particleHandle = StartParticleFxLoopedOnEntity(ptName, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
        end
        if evolution then
            SetParticleFxLoopedEvolution(particleHandle, evolution.name, evolution.amount, false)
        end
        if color then
            SetParticleFxLoopedColour(particleHandle, color.r, color.g, color.b, false)
        end
        SetParticleFxLoopedAlpha(particleHandle, alpha or 1.0)
        if duration then
            Wait(duration)
            StopParticleFxLooped(particleHandle, false)
        end
    else
        SetParticleFxNonLoopedAlpha(alpha or 1.0)
        if color then
            SetParticleFxNonLoopedColour(color.r, color.g, color.b)
        end
        if boneID then
            StartParticleFxNonLoopedOnPedBone(ptName, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, boneID, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
        else
            StartParticleFxNonLoopedOnEntity(ptName, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
        end
    end
    return particleHandle
end

---@param entity number
---@return number materialHash
---@return number entityHit
---@return vector3 surfaceNormal
---@return vector3 endCoords
---@return boolean success
---@return number status
functions.GetGroundHash = function(entity)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local handle = StartShapeTestCapsule(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 4, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z - 2.0, 1, 1, entity, 7)
    local status, success, endCoords, surfaceNormal, materialHash, entityHit
    while true do
        status, success, endCoords, surfaceNormal, materialHash, entityHit = GetShapeTestResultEx(handle)
        if status ~= 1 then break end
        Wait(0)
    end
    return materialHash, entityHit, surfaceNormal, endCoords, success, status
end

if GetConvar('qbx:enablebridge', 'true') == 'false' then return end

require 'bridge.qb.client.drawtext'
require 'bridge.qb.client.events'

local qbCoreCompat = {}
qbCoreCompat.PlayerData = QBX.PlayerData
qbCoreCompat.Config = lib.table.merge(require 'config.client', require 'config.shared')
qbCoreCompat.Shared = require 'bridge.qb.shared.main'
qbCoreCompat.Shared.Jobs = GetJobs()
qbCoreCompat.Shared.Gangs = GetGangs()
qbCoreCompat.Functions = require 'bridge.qb.client.functions'

---@diagnostic disable: deprecated

---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Client instead
qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks = {}

---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Client instead
qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks = {}

-- Callback Events --

-- Client Callback
---@deprecated call a function instead
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerClientCallback', function(name, ...)
    qbCoreCompat.Functions.TriggerClientCallback(name, function(...)
        TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerClientCallback', name, ...)
    end, ...)
end)

-- Server Callback
---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Client instead
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerCallback', function(name, ...)
    local serverCallback = qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks[name]
    if not serverCallback then return end
    qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks[name] = nil

    if serverCallback.promise then
        serverCallback.promise:resolve((...))
    end
    if serverCallback.callback then
        serverCallback.callback(...)
    end
end)

-- Callback Functions --

-- Client Callback
---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Client instead
function qbCoreCompat.Functions.CreateClientCallback(name, cb)
    qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks[name] = cb
end

---@deprecated call a function instead
function qbCoreCompat.Functions.TriggerClientCallback(name, cb, ...)
    if not qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks[name] then return end
    qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks[name](cb, ...)
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
local function isFunction(value)
    return type(value) == 'function' or type(value) == 'table' and type(value.__cfx_functionReference) == 'string'
end

-- Server Callback
---Without a callback as the second argument, waits for the response and returns its first value.
---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Client instead
---@param name string
---@param cb? function
---@return any
function qbCoreCompat.Functions.TriggerCallback(name, cb, ...)
    if isFunction(cb) then
        qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks[name] = { callback = cb }
        TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerCallback', name, ...)
        return
    end

    local p = promise.new()
    qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks[name] = { promise = p }
    TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerCallback', name, cb, ...)
    return Citizen.Await(p)
end

---@deprecated Use lib.print.debug()
---@param obj any
function qbCoreCompat.Debug(_, obj)
    lib.print.debug(obj)
end

local createQbExport = require 'bridge.qb.shared.export-function'

---@param filters? string[]
createQbExport('GetCoreObject', function(filters)
    if type(filters) ~= 'table' then return qbCoreCompat end

    local results = {}
    for i = 1, #filters do
        local key = filters[i]
        results[key] = qbCoreCompat[key]
    end
    return results
end)

---@deprecated use exports.ox_inventory:Items() instead
createQbExport('GetSharedItems', function()
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items
end)

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:GetVehiclesByName() instead
createQbExport('GetSharedVehicles', function()
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Vehicles
end)

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:GetWeapons() instead
createQbExport('GetSharedWeapons', function()
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Weapons
end)

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:GetJobs() instead
createQbExport('GetSharedJobs', function()
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Jobs
end)

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:GetGangs() instead
createQbExport('GetSharedGangs', function()
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Gangs
end)

---@deprecated
---@param namespace string
---@param item any
createQbExport('GetShared', function(namespace, item)
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared[namespace]?[item]
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData', function()
    qbCoreCompat.PlayerData = QBX.PlayerData
end)

---@deprecated qbx_core sends shared data changes through QBCore:Client:OnSharedUpdate
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:SharedUpdate', function(shared)
    if type(shared) ~= 'table' then return end
    for key, value in pairs(shared) do
        if type(qbCoreCompat.Shared[key]) ~= 'function' then
            qbCoreCompat.Shared[key] = value
        end
    end
end)

local exportedElsewhere = { DrawText = true }
for name, func in pairs(qbCoreCompat.Functions) do
    if type(func) == 'function' and not exportedElsewhere[name] then
        createQbExport(name, func)
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('qbx_core:client:onJobUpdate', function(jobName, job)
    qbCoreCompat.Shared.Jobs[jobName] = job
end)

RegisterNetEvent('qbx_core:client:onGangUpdate', function(gangName, gang)
    qbCoreCompat.Shared.Gangs[gangName] = gang
end)

---@deprecated
commands.List = {}

---@deprecated
commands.IgnoreList = { ['god'] = true, ['user'] = true }

---@deprecated
function commands.Add(name, help, arguments, argsrequired, callback, permission)
    commands.List[name:lower()] = {
        name = name:lower(),
        permission = permission,
        help = help,
        arguments = arguments,
        argsrequired = argsrequired,
        callback = callback,
    }

    local properties = {
        help = help,
        restricted = permission and permission ~= 'user' and 'group.'..permission or false,
        params = {}
    }
    for i = 1, #arguments do
        local argument = arguments[i]
        properties.params[i] = {
            name = argument.name,
            help = argument.help,
            type = argument.type or nil,
            optional = not argsrequired or argument?.optional
        }
    end
    lib.addCommand(name, properties, function(source, args, raw)
        local _args = {}
        if #args > 0 then
            _args = args
        else
            for i = 1, #arguments do
                _args[i] = args[arguments[i].name]
            end
        end
        callback(source, _args, raw)
    end)
end

---@deprecated
function commands.Refresh(_) end

return commands

-- Vehicles
RegisterServerEvent('baseevents:enteringVehicle', function(veh, seat, modelName, netId)
    local src = source
    local data = {
        vehicle = veh,
        seat = seat,
        name = modelName,
        netId = netId,
        event = 'Entering'
    }
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:VehicleInfo', src, data)
end)

RegisterServerEvent('baseevents:enteredVehicle', function(veh, seat, modelName, netId)
    local src = source
    local data = {
        vehicle = veh,
        seat = seat,
        name = modelName,
        netId = netId,
        event = 'Entered'
    }
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:VehicleInfo', src, data)
end)

RegisterServerEvent('baseevents:enteringAborted', function()
    local src = source
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:AbortVehicleEntering', src)
end)

RegisterServerEvent('baseevents:leftVehicle', function(veh, seat, modelName, netId)
    local src = source
    local data = {
        vehicle = veh,
        seat = seat,
        name = modelName,
        netId = netId,
        event = 'Left'
    }
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:VehicleInfo', src, data)
end)

local saveCooldownMs <const> = 10000
---@type table<Source, integer>
local nextSaveAllowed = {}
---@type table<Source, table<string, true>>
local warnedItemEvents = {}

---@deprecated qbx_core saves players and drains hunger/thirst on its own interval
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:UpdatePlayer', function()
    local src = source --[[@as Source]]
    local player = GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if (nextSaveAllowed[src] or 0) > now then return end
    nextSaveAllowed[src] = now + saveCooldownMs

    local metadata = player.PlayerData.metadata
    TriggerClientEvent('hud:client:UpdateNeeds', src, metadata.hunger, metadata.thirst)
    Save(src)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    nextSaveAllowed[source] = nil
    warnedItemEvents[source] = nil
end)

---@param eventName string
---@param src Source
---@param itemName any
---@param amount any
local function warnDeprecatedItemEvent(eventName, src, itemName, amount)
    local warned = warnedItemEvents[src] or {}
    if warned[eventName] then return end
    warned[eventName] = true
    warnedItemEvents[src] = warned

    lib.print.warn(('Player %s triggered deprecated, exploitable net event %s (item: %s, amount: %s). It is ignored: give, remove and use items on the server through ox_inventory.'):format(
        src, eventName, tostring(type(itemName) == 'table' and rawget(itemName, 'name') or itemName):sub(1, 64), tonumber(amount) or 'nil'))
end

---@deprecated exploitable, ignored. Use items through ox_inventory
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:UseItem', function(item)
    warnDeprecatedItemEvent('QBCore:Server:UseItem', source, item)
end)

---@deprecated exploitable, ignored. Remove items on the server through ox_inventory
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:RemoveItem', function(itemName, amount)
    warnDeprecatedItemEvent('QBCore:Server:RemoveItem', source, itemName, amount)
end)

---@deprecated exploitable, ignored. Add items on the server through ox_inventory
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:AddItem', function(itemName, amount)
    warnDeprecatedItemEvent('QBCore:Server:AddItem', source, itemName, amount)
end)

    end

---@param source? Source
---@param coords? vector3 | vector4 | { x: number, y: number, z: number }
---@return vector3 origin
---@return integer ped
local function getSearchOrigin(source, coords)
    local ped = source and GetPlayerPed(source --[[@as string]]) or 0
    if coords then return vec3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z), ped end
    return GetEntityCoords(ped), ped
end

---@param entities integer[]
---@param origin vector3
---@param ignore? integer
---@return integer closestEntity -1 if none found
---@return number closestDistance -1 if none found
local function getClosestEntity(entities, origin, ignore)
    local closestEntity, closestDistance = -1, -1
    for i = 1, #entities do
        local entity = entities[i]
        if entity ~= ignore then
            local distance = #(GetEntityCoords(entity) - origin)
            if closestDistance == -1 or distance < closestDistance then
                closestEntity, closestDistance = entity, distance
            end
        end
    end
    return closestEntity, closestDistance
end

---@deprecated use lib.getClosestPlayer from ox_lib
---@param source? Source excluded from the search; its ped's coords are used when coords is nil
---@param coords? vector3 | vector4 | { x: number, y: number, z: number }
---@return integer closestPlayer -1 if none found
---@return number closestDistance -1 if none found
function functions.GetClosestPlayer(source, coords)
    local origin, ped = getSearchOrigin(source, coords)
    local peds, owners = {}, {}
    for _, playerId in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        local playerPed = GetPlayerPed(playerId)
        if playerPed ~= 0 then
            peds[#peds + 1] = playerPed
            owners[playerPed] = tonumber(playerId)
        end
    end
    local closestPed, closestDistance = getClosestEntity(peds, origin, ped)
    return owners[closestPed] or -1, closestDistance
end

function functions.GetClosestPed(source, coords)

local maxConcurrentSpawns <const> = 20
local spawnTimeoutMs <const> = 10000
---@type table<Source, integer>
local activeSpawns = {}

---@param source Source
local function releaseSpawn(source)
    local count = (activeSpawns[source] or 1) - 1
    activeSpawns[source] = count > 0 and count or nil
end

---@deprecated use qbx.spawnVehicle from modules/lib.lua
---@return number?
function functions.SpawnVehicle(source, model, coords, warp)
    if (activeSpawns[source] or 0) >= maxConcurrentSpawns then return end
    activeSpawns[source] = (activeSpawns[source] or 0) + 1

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)
    model = type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or model
    if not coords then coords = GetEntityCoords(ped) end
    local heading = coords.w and coords.w or 0.0
    local veh = CreateVehicle(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading, true, true)

    local spawnTimeout = GetGameTimer() + spawnTimeoutMs
    while not DoesEntityExist(veh) and GetGameTimer() < spawnTimeout do Wait(0) end
    if not DoesEntityExist(veh) then
        releaseSpawn(source)
        return
    end

    if warp then
        local warpTimeout = GetGameTimer() + spawnTimeoutMs
        while GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false) ~= veh and GetGameTimer() < warpTimeout do
            Wait(0)
            TaskWarpPedIntoVehicle(ped, veh, -1)
        end
    end

    local ownerTimeout = GetGameTimer() + spawnTimeoutMs
    while NetworkGetEntityOwner(veh) ~= source and GetGameTimer() < ownerTimeout do Wait(0) end

    releaseSpawn(source)
    return veh
end

---@deprecated use qbx.spawnVehicle from modules/lib.lua
function functions.CreateVehicle(source, model, _, coords, warp)
    model = type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or (model --[[@as integer]])
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)

    local netId = qbx.spawnVehicle({
        model = model,
        spawnSource = coords or ped,
        warp = warp and ped or nil,
    })

    return NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
end

    reason = ('\n %s \n 🔸 Check our Discord for further information: %s'):format(reason, discordLink)

        setKickReason(reason)
    end

        end
    end)

    local players = GetPlayers()

    for _, player in pairs(players) do
        local plyLicense2 = GetPlayerIdentifierByType(player --[[@as string]], 'license2')

---Items added or changed through the bridge at runtime, resent to players who load in later
---@type table<string, table>
local runtimeItems = {}

---@param itemName string
---@param item table
---@return string
local function toOxItemDefinition(itemName, item)
    return ('[%q] = { label = %q, weight = %s, stack = %s, close = %s, description = %q },'):format(
        itemName,
        tostring(item.label or itemName),
        tonumber(item.weight) or 0,
        tostring(not item.unique),
        tostring(item.shouldClose ~= false),
        tostring(item.description or '')
    )
end

---@param action string
---@param itemName string
---@param item table
local function warnItemNotInInventory(action, itemName, item)
    if exports.ox_inventory:Items(itemName) then return end
    lib.print.warn(("%s used deprecated %s for '%s'. Only QBCore.Shared.Items was changed: ox_inventory cannot register items at runtime, so the item cannot be given or used until it is defined in ox_inventory/data/items.lua, e.g.\n%s"):format(
        GetInvokingResource() or 'unknown resource', action, itemName, toOxItemDefinition(itemName, item)))
end

---@param itemName string
---@param item table
local function setSharedItem(itemName, item)
    item.name = item.name or itemName
    qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items[itemName] = item
    runtimeItems[itemName] = item
end

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerLoaded', function(player)
    if not next(runtimeItems) then return end
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnSharedUpdateMultiple', player.PlayerData.source, 'Items', runtimeItems)
end)

---@deprecated ox_inventory cannot register items at runtime. Define the item in ox_inventory/data/items.lua instead.
---@param itemName string
---@param item table
---@return boolean success
---@return string message
function functions.AddItem(itemName, item)
    if type(itemName) ~= 'string' then
        return false, 'invalid_item_name'
    end

    if qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items[itemName] then
        return false, 'item_exists'
    end

    if type(item) ~= 'table' then
        return false, 'invalid_item'
    end

    setSharedItem(itemName, item)
    warnItemNotInInventory('AddItem', itemName, item)

    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnSharedUpdate', -1, 'Items', itemName, item)
    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:UpdateObject')
    return true, 'success'
end

---@deprecated ox_inventory cannot update items at runtime. Edit the item in ox_inventory/data/items.lua instead.
---@param itemName string
---@param item table
---@return boolean success
---@return string message
function functions.UpdateItem(itemName, item)
    if type(itemName) ~= 'string' then
        return false, 'invalid_item_name'
    end

    if not qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items[itemName] then
        return false, 'item_not_exists'
    end

    if type(item) ~= 'table' then
        return false, 'invalid_item'
    end

    setSharedItem(itemName, item)
    lib.print.warn(("%s used deprecated UpdateItem for '%s'. Only QBCore.Shared.Items was changed; the ox_inventory definition is unchanged."):format(GetInvokingResource() or 'unknown resource', itemName))

    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnSharedUpdate', -1, 'Items', itemName, item)
    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:UpdateObject')
    return true, 'success'
end

---@deprecated ox_inventory cannot register items at runtime. Define the items in ox_inventory/data/items.lua instead.
---@param items table<string, table>
---@return boolean success
---@return string message
---@return table? errorItem
function functions.AddItems(items)
    if type(items) ~= 'table' then
        return false, 'invalid_item_name'
    end

    for key, value in pairs(items) do
        if type(key) ~= 'string' then
            return false, 'invalid_item_name', value
        end

        if qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items[key] then
            return false, 'item_exists', value
        end

        if type(value) ~= 'table' then
            return false, 'invalid_item', value
        end
    end

    for key, value in pairs(items) do
        setSharedItem(key, value)
        warnItemNotInInventory('AddItems', key, value)
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnSharedUpdateMultiple', -1, 'Items', items)
    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:UpdateObject')
    return true, 'success'
end

---@deprecated ox_inventory cannot remove items at runtime. Remove the item from ox_inventory/data/items.lua instead.
---@param itemName string
---@return boolean success
---@return string message
function functions.RemoveItem(itemName)
    if type(itemName) ~= 'string' then
        return false, 'invalid_item_name'
    end

    if not qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items[itemName] then
        return false, 'item_not_exists'
    end

    qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items[itemName] = nil
    runtimeItems[itemName] = nil
    if exports.ox_inventory:Items(itemName) then
        lib.print.warn(("%s used deprecated RemoveItem for '%s'. Only QBCore.Shared.Items was changed; ox_inventory still defines the item."):format(GetInvokingResource() or 'unknown resource', itemName))
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnSharedUpdate', -1, 'Items', itemName, nil)
    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:UpdateObject')
    return true, 'success'
end

---@deprecated use export CreateJobs

---@param job Job

local function addJob(jobName, job)
    if type(jobName) ~= 'string' then
        return false, 'invalid_job_name'
    end

    if GetJob(jobName) then
        return false, 'job_exists'
    end

    local success, message = CreateJobs({[jobName] = job})
    if not success then return false, message end
    return true, 'success'
end

---Add a new function to the Functions table of the player class
---Use-case:
-- [[
--     AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerLoaded', function(Player)
--         functions.AddPlayerMethod(Player.PlayerData.source, 'functionName', function(oneArg, orMore)
--             -- do something here
--         end)
--     end)
-- ]]
---@deprecated
---@param ids number|number[] which players to add the method to. -1 for all players
---@param methodName string
---@param handler function
function functions.AddPlayerMethod(ids, methodName, handler)
    local idType = type(ids)
    if idType == 'number' then
        if ids == -1 then
            for _, v in pairs(QBX.Players) do
                v.Functions.AddMethod(methodName, handler)
            end
        else
            if not QBX.Players[ids] then return end
            QBX.Players[ids].Functions.AddMethod(methodName, handler)
        end
    elseif idType == 'table' and table.type(ids) == 'array' then
        for i = 1, #ids do
            ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: deprecated
            functions.AddPlayerMethod(ids[i], methodName, handler)
        end
    end
end

---Use-case:
--[[
    AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerLoaded', function(Player)
        functions.AddPlayerField(Player.PlayerData.source, 'fieldName', 'fieldData')
    end)
]]

---@param fieldName string
---@param data any
function functions.AddPlayerField(ids, fieldName, data)
    local idType = type(ids)
    if idType == 'number' then
        if ids == -1 then
            for _, v in pairs(QBX.Players) do
                ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: undefined-field
                v.Functions.AddField(fieldName, data)
            end
        else
            if not QBX.Players[ids] then return end

            ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: undefined-field
            QBX.Players[ids].Functions.AddField(fieldName, data)
        end
    elseif idType == 'table' and table.type(ids) == 'array' then
        for i = 1, #ids do
            ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: deprecated
            functions.AddPlayerField(ids[i], fieldName, data)
        end
    end
end

---@param job string job name or job type
---@param checkOnDuty? boolean only include players on duty
---@return Source[]
---@return integer
function functions.GetPlayersByJob(job, checkOnDuty)
    local players = {}
    for source, player in pairs(QBX.Players) do
        local playerJob = player.PlayerData.job
        if (playerJob.name == job or playerJob.type == job) and (not checkOnDuty or playerJob.onduty) then
            players[#players + 1] = source
        end
    end
    return players, #players
end

---Opt in or out of admin reports
---@param source Source
function functions.ToggleOptin(source)
    exports.qbx_core:ToggleOptin(source)
end

-- Check if player is banned
---@param source Source
---@return boolean
---@return string? playerMessage
function functions.IsPlayerBanned(source)
    return exports.qbx_core:IsPlayerBanned(source)
end

---@see client/functions.lua:functions.Notify
function functions.Notify(source, text, notifyType, duration, subTitle, notifyPosition, notifyStyle, notifyIcon, notifyIconColor)
    exports.qbx_core:Notify(source, text, notifyType, duration, subTitle, notifyPosition, notifyStyle, notifyIcon, notifyIconColor)
end

---@param InvokingResource string
---@return string version
function functions.GetCoreVersion(InvokingResource)
    return exports.qbx_core:GetCoreVersion(InvokingResource)
end

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:GenerateUniqueIdentifier('AccountNumber')
---@return string
function functions.CreateAccountNumber()
    return GenerateUniqueIdentifier('AccountNumber')
end

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:GenerateUniqueIdentifier('PhoneNumber')
---@return string
function functions.CreatePhoneNumber()
    return GenerateUniqueIdentifier('PhoneNumber')
end

---@deprecated use parameterized queries instead
---@param source Source
---@param data any
---@param pattern string
---@return boolean matches whether the whole value matches pattern
function functions.PrepForSQL(source, data, pattern)
    data = tostring(data)
    local result = data:match(pattern)
    if result and #result == #data then return true end

    local player = GetPlayer(source)
    logger.log({
        source = GetInvokingResource() or cache.resource,
        webhook = loggingConfig.webhook['anticheat'],
        event = 'SQL Exploit Attempted',
        color = 'red',
        tags = loggingConfig.role,
        message = ('%s attempted to exploit SQL!'):format(player and player.PlayerData.license or GetPlayerName(source --[[@as string]]) or source),
    })
    return false
end

---@deprecated
---@return { exists: boolean, database: string }
function functions.GetDatabaseInfo()
    local details = { exists = false, database = '' }
    local connectionString = GetConvar('mysql_connection_string', '')

    if connectionString == '' then
        return details
    end

    if connectionString:find('mysql://', 1, true) then
        local hostAndPath = connectionString:match('^mysql://.*@(.*)$') or connectionString:sub(9)
        local database = hostAndPath:match('^[^/]*/([^%?]+)')
        details.database = database or ''
        details.exists = database ~= nil
        return details
    end

    for _, option in ipairs({ string.strsplit(';', connectionString) }) do
        local key, value = option:match('^%s*([^=]+)=(.*)$')
        if key and key:lower() == 'database' then
            details.database = value
            details.exists = true
            return details
        end
    end

    return details
end

return functions

if GetConvar('qbx:enablebridge', 'true') == 'false' then return end

require 'bridge.qb.server.debug'
require 'bridge.qb.server.events'

local compat = require 'bridge.qb.shared.compat'
compat.convertItems()
RegisterCommand('convertqbitems', function() compat.convertItems(true) end, true)

---@diagnostic disable-next-line: lowercase-global
qbCoreCompat = {}

qbCoreCompat.Config = lib.table.merge(require 'config.server', require 'config.shared')
qbCoreCompat.Shared = require 'bridge.qb.shared.main'

local qbItemsLoaded, qbItems = pcall(compat.getQbItems)
if qbItemsLoaded then
    for name, item in pairs(qbItems) do
        if not qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items[name] then
            item.name = item.name or name
            qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items[name] = item
        end
    end
end

qbCoreCompat.Shared.Jobs = GetJobs()
qbCoreCompat.Shared.Gangs = GetGangs()
qbCoreCompat.Players = QBX.Players
qbCoreCompat.Player = require 'bridge.qb.server.player'
qbCoreCompat.Player_Buckets = QBX.Player_Buckets
qbCoreCompat.Entity_Buckets = QBX.Entity_Buckets
qbCoreCompat.UsableItems = QBX.UsableItems
qbCoreCompat.Functions = require 'bridge.qb.server.functions'
qbCoreCompat.Commands = require 'bridge.qb.server.commands'

---@diagnostic disable: deprecated

---@deprecated Call lib.print.debug() instead
qbCoreCompat.Debug = lib.print.debug

---@deprecated Call lib.print.error() instead
qbCoreCompat.ShowError = lib.print.error

---@deprecated Use lib.print.info() instead
qbCoreCompat.ShowSuccess = lib.print.info

---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Server instead
qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks = {}

---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Server instead
qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks = {}

-- Callback Events --

-- Client Callback
---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Server instead
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerClientCallback', function(name, ...)
    local key = ('%s:%s'):format(source, name)
    local cb = qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks[key]
    if cb then
        qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks[key] = nil
        cb(...)
    end
end)

-- Server Callback
---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Server instead
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerCallback', function(name, ...)
    local src = source
    qbCoreCompat.Functions.TriggerCallback(name, src, function(...)
        TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerCallback', src, name, ...)
    end, ...)
end)

--- @deprecated
RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:CallCommand', function(command, args)
    local src = source --[[@as Source]]
    local player = GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end
    if IsPlayerAceAllowed(src --[[@as string]], ('command.%s'):format(command)) then
        local commandString = command
        for _, value in pairs(args) do
            commandString = ('%s %s'):format(commandString, value)
        end
        TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Command:CallCommand', src, commandString)
    end
end)

-- Callback Functions --

-- Client Callback
---Without a callback after source, waits for the client's response and returns it.
---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Server instead
---@param name string
---@param source Source
---@param ... any optional callback, then arguments sent to the client
---@return any ...
function qbCoreCompat.Functions.TriggerClientCallback(name, source, ...)
    if not source then return end
    local args = table.pack(...)
    local key = ('%s:%s'):format(source, name)

    if qbCoreCompat.Shared.IsFunction(args[1]) then
        qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks[key] = args[1]
        TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerClientCallback', source, name, table.unpack(args, 2, args.n))
        return
    end

    local p = promise.new()
    qbCoreCompat.ClientCallbacks[key] = function(...)
        p:resolve(table.pack(...))
    end
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerClientCallback', source, name, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
    local result = Citizen.Await(p)
    return table.unpack(result, 1, result.n)
end

-- Server Callback
---@deprecated use https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Callback/Lua/Server instead
function qbCoreCompat.Functions.CreateCallback(name, cb)
    qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks[name] = cb
end

---@deprecated call a function instead
function qbCoreCompat.Functions.TriggerCallback(name, source, cb, ...)
    if not qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks[name] then return end
    qbCoreCompat.ServerCallbacks[name](source, cb, ...)
end

---@deprecated call server function qbx.spawnVehicle from modules/lib.lua
qbCoreCompat.Functions.CreateCallback('QBCore:Server:SpawnVehicle', function(source, cb, model, coords, warp)
    local vehId = qbCoreCompat.Functions.SpawnVehicle(source, model, coords, warp)

    if vehId then cb(NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehId)) end
end)

---@deprecated call server function qbx.spawnVehicle from modules/lib.lua

    local vehId = qbCoreCompat.Functions.CreateVehicle(source, model, nil, coords, warp)

    if vehId then cb(NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehId)) end
end)

AddEventHandler('qbx_core:server:onJobUpdate', function(jobName)
    qbCoreCompat.Shared.Jobs[jobName] = GetJob(jobName)
end)

AddEventHandler('qbx_core:server:onGangUpdate', function(gangName)
    qbCoreCompat.Shared.Gangs[gangName] = GetGang(gangName)
end)

local createQbExport = require 'bridge.qb.shared.export-function'

---@param filters? string[] only return these top-level keys
createQbExport('GetCoreObject', function(filters)
    if type(filters) ~= 'table' then return qbCoreCompat end

    local results = {}
    for i = 1, #filters do
        local key = filters[i]
        results[key] = qbCoreCompat[key]
    end
    return results
end)

createQbExport('GetSharedItems', function()
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Items
end)

    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Vehicles
end)

    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Weapons
end)

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:GetJobs() instead
createQbExport('GetSharedJobs', function()
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Jobs
end)

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:GetGangs() instead
createQbExport('GetSharedGangs', function()
    return qbCoreCompat.Shared.Gangs
end)

---@deprecated
---@param namespace string
---@param item any
createQbExport('GetShared', function(namespace, item)
    local shared = qbCoreCompat.Shared[namespace]
    if type(shared) == 'table' then return shared[item] end
end)

---@deprecated use exports.qbx_core:ExploitBan() instead
---@param playerId Source
---@param origin string
createQbExport('ExploitBan', function(playerId, origin)
    exports.qbx_core:ExploitBan(playerId, origin)
end)

for name, fn in pairs(qbCoreCompat.Functions) do
    if type(fn) == 'function' then
        createQbExport(name, fn)
    end
end

function AddDeprecatedFunctions(player)
    if not player then return end

    ---@deprecated call ox_inventory instead
    function player.Functions.GetCardSlot()
        error('player.Functions.GetCardSlot is unsupported. Call ox_inventory directly')
    end

    return player
end

local playerObj = {}

---@deprecated ox_inventory automatically saves
---@param source Source
function playerObj.SaveInventory(source) -- luacheck: ignore
    assert(GetResourceState('qb-inventory') ~= 'started', 'qb-inventory is not compatible with qbx_core. use ox_inventory instead')
end

---@deprecated ox_inventory automatically saves
---@param playerData PlayerData
function playerObj.SaveOfflineInventory(playerData) -- luacheck: ignore
    assert(GetResourceState('qb-inventory') ~= 'started', 'qb-inventory is not compatible with qbx_core. use ox_inventory instead')
end

---@deprecated call ox_inventory exports directly
---@param items any[]
---@return number?
function playerObj.GetTotalWeight(items) -- luacheck: ignore
    assert(GetResourceState('qb-inventory') ~= 'started', 'qb-inventory is not compatible with qbx_core. use ox_inventory instead')
end

---@deprecated call ox_inventory exports directly
---@param items any[]
---@param itemName string
---@return integer[]? slots
function playerObj.GetSlotsByItem(items, itemName) -- luacheck: ignore
    assert(GetResourceState('qb-inventory') ~= 'started', 'qb-inventory is not compatible with qbx_core. use ox_inventory instead')
end

---@deprecated call ox_inventory exports directly
---@param items any[]
---@param itemName string
---@return integer? slot
function playerObj.GetFirstSlotByItem(items, itemName) -- luacheck: ignore
    assert(GetResourceState('qb-inventory') ~= 'started', 'qb-inventory is not compatible with qbx_core. use ox_inventory instead')
end

---@param source Source
---@param citizenid? string
---@param newData? PlayerEntity
---@return boolean success
function playerObj.Login(source, citizenid, newData)
    return exports.qbx_core:Login(source, citizenid, newData)
end

---@param citizenid string
---@return Player? player if found in storage
function playerObj.GetOfflinePlayer(citizenid)
    return AddDeprecatedFunctions(exports.qbx_core:GetOfflinePlayer(citizenid))
end

---Loads the most recently played character of a license. qbx stores license2 when available, so either license form matches.
---@param license string
---@return Player?
function playerObj.GetOfflinePlayerByLicense(license)
    if type(license) ~= 'string' then return end
    local citizenid = MySQL.scalar.await([[
        SELECT p.citizenid FROM players p
        LEFT JOIN users u ON u.userId = p.userId
        WHERE p.license = ? OR u.license = ? OR u.license2 = ?
        ORDER BY p.last_logged_out DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ]], { license, license, license })
    return citizenid and playerObj.GetOfflinePlayer(citizenid)
end

---@param license string
---@return Player?
function playerObj.GetPlayerByLicense(license)
    if type(license) ~= 'string' then return end
    local source = exports.qbx_core:GetSource(license)
    if source > 0 then
        return AddDeprecatedFunctions(exports.qbx_core:GetPlayer(source))
    end
    return playerObj.GetOfflinePlayerByLicense(license)
end

---@deprecated unsupported. Call Login or CreatePlayer
function playerObj.CheckPlayerData()
    error('Unsupported. Call Login or CreatePlayer')
end

---On player logout
---@param source Source
function playerObj.Logout(source)
    exports.qbx_core:Logout(source)
end

---Create a new character
---Don't touch any of this unless you know what you are doing
---Will cause major issues!
---@param playerData PlayerData
---@param Offline boolean
---@return Player?
function playerObj.CreatePlayer(playerData, Offline)
    return AddDeprecatedFunctions(exports.qbx_core:CreatePlayer(playerData, Offline))
end

---Save player info to database (make sure citizenid is the primary key in your database)
---@param source Source
function playerObj.Save(source)
    exports.qbx_core:Save(source)
end

---@param playerData PlayerEntity
function playerObj.SaveOffline(playerData)
    exports.qbx_core:SaveOffline(playerData)
end

playerObj.DeleteCharacter = DeleteCharacter

---@param citizenid string
function playerObj.ForceDeleteCharacter(citizenid)
    exports.qbx_core:DeleteCharacter(citizenid)
end

---Generate unique values for player identifiers
---@param type UniqueIdType The type of unique value to generate
---@return string | number UniqueVal unique value generated
function playerObj.GenerateUniqueIdentifier(type)
    return exports.qbx_core:GenerateUniqueIdentifier(type)
end


---@deprecated player.GenerateUniqueIdentifier('citizenid') instead
---@return string citizenid unique citizenid generated
function playerObj.CreateCitizenId()
    return exports.qbx_core:GenerateUniqueIdentifier('citizenid')
end

---@deprecated player.GenerateUniqueIdentifier('FingerId') instead
---@return string
function playerObj.CreateFingerId()
    return exports.qbx_core:GenerateUniqueIdentifier('FingerId')
end

---@deprecated player.GenerateUniqueIdentifier('WalletId') instead
---@return string
function playerObj.CreateWalletId()

end

---@return integer
function playerObj.CreateSerialNumber()

end

return playerObj

-- Item conversion borrowed from ox_inventory: https://github.com/overextended/ox_inventory/blob/52d99285eef1dc7df31c084679db3fdf6b1c0150/modules/items/server.lua#L115-L217
-- Copyright (c) 2023 Overextended

local outputFile = 'converted.lua'

local weaponPartPatterns = {
    '_ammo$',
    '_attachment$',
    '_muzzle_brake$',
    'tint_',
    '^%a*pistol50?_',
    '^%a*revolver_',
    '^%a*mg_',
    '^%a*pdw_',
    '^%a*shotgun_',
    '^%a*rifle_',
    '^%a*carbine_',
    '^gusenberg_',
    '^%a*sniper_',
    '^snipermax_',
}

local escapes = { ['\\'] = '\\\\', ["'"] = "\\'", ['\n'] = '\\n', ['\r'] = '\\r', ['\t'] = '\\t' }

local function quote(str)
    return "'" .. str:gsub('[\\\'%c]', function(char)
        return escapes[char] or ('\\%03d'):format(char:byte())
    end) .. "'"
end

local function toNumber(value)
    value = tonumber(value)

    if value and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge then
        return math.tointeger(value) or value
    end
end

local function isWeaponPart(name)
    for i = 1, #weaponPartPatterns do
        if name:find(weaponPartPatterns[i]) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function convertImage(name, image)
    if type(image) ~= 'string' or image == '' then return end
    if image:find('^%w+://') then return image end

    if not image:find('%.%w+$') then
        image = image .. '.png'
    end

    if image ~= name .. '.png' then
        return image
    end
end

local function formatItem(name, item)
    local lines = {
        ('\t[%s] = {'):format(quote(name)),
        ('\t\tlabel = %s,'):format(quote(type(item.label) == 'string' and item.label or name)),
        ('\t\tweight = %s,'):format(toNumber(item.weight) or 0),
    }

    if item.unique then
        lines[#lines + 1] = '\t\tstack = false,'
    end

    if item.shouldClose == false then
        lines[#lines + 1] = '\t\tclose = false,'
    end

    if type(item.description) == 'string' and item.description ~= '' then
        lines[#lines + 1] = ('\t\tdescription = %s,'):format(quote(item.description))
    end

    local decay = toNumber(item.decay)

    -- QBCore inventory forks store decay in days, ox_inventory stores degrade in minutes
    if decay and decay > 0 then
        lines[#lines + 1] = ('\t\tdegrade = %s,'):format(toNumber(decay * 1440))
    end

    local image = convertImage(name, item.image)

    if image then
        lines[#lines + 1] = '\t\tclient = {'
        lines[#lines + 1] = ('\t\t\timage = %s,'):format(quote(image))
        lines[#lines + 1] = '\t\t},'
    end

    lines[#lines + 1] = '\t},'

    return table.concat(lines, '\n')
end

local function loadFile(resource, path, env)
    local chunk = LoadResourceFile(resource, path)

    if not chunk then return end

    local fn, err = load(chunk, ('@@%s/%s'):format(resource, path), 't', env or _ENV)

    if not fn then error(err, 0) end

    return fn()
end

local function getQbItems()
    local env = setmetatable({ QBShared = {} }, { __index = _ENV })
    local result = loadFile(cache.resource, 'shared/items.lua', env)
    local items = {}

    local function collect(list)
        if type(list) ~= 'table' then return end

        for key, item in pairs(list) do
            local name = type(item) == 'table' and (type(item.name) == 'string' and item.name or type(key) == 'string' and key)

            if name and name ~= '' then
                items[name:lower()] = item
            end
        end
    end

    collect(result)
    collect(type(env.QBShared) == 'table' and env.QBShared.Items)

    return items
end

local function getOxItemNames()
    local items = loadFile('ox_inventory', 'data/items.lua')

    if type(items) ~= 'table' then
        error('ox_inventory/data/items.lua could not be read', 0)
    end

    local names = {}

    for name in pairs(items) do
        names[tostring(name):lower()] = true
    end

    for _, category in pairs(loadFile('ox_inventory', 'data/weapons.lua') or {}) do
        for name in pairs(type(category) == 'table' and category or {}) do
            names[tostring(name):lower()] = true
        end
    end

    return names
end

local function saveConverted(names, items, weapons, weaponParts)
    local file = {
        '-- Generated by qbx_core from shared/items.lua: QBCore items that ox_inventory/data/items.lua does not define yet.',
        '-- Copy every entry between "return {" and the last "}" into ox_inventory/data/items.lua, just before its last "}".',
        '-- This file is rewritten on every start while items are still missing, so make your edits in ox_inventory.',
    }

    if #weapons > 0 then
        file[#file + 1] = ('-- Weapons not defined in ox_inventory/data/weapons.lua (add them there): %s'):format(table.concat(weapons, ', '))
    end

    if #weaponParts > 0 then
        file[#file + 1] = ('-- Ammo, attachments and tints not converted (ox_inventory defines its own in data/weapons.lua): %s'):format(table.concat(weaponParts, ', '))
    end

    file[#file + 1] = 'return {'

    for i = 1, #names do
        file[#file + 1] = formatItem(names[i], items[names[i]])
    end

    file[#file + 1] = '}\n'

    return SaveResourceFile(cache.resource, outputFile, table.concat(file, '\n'), -1)
end

---@param verbose? boolean
local function convertItems(verbose)
    local success, items = pcall(getQbItems)

    if not success then
        lib.print.error(('Unable to read QBCore items from qbx_core/shared/items.lua: %s'):format(items))
        return
    end

    if not next(items) then
        if verbose then
            lib.print.info('qbx_core/shared/items.lua has no QBCore items to convert')
        end
        return
    end

    local oxItems
    success, oxItems = pcall(getOxItemNames)

    if not success then
        lib.print.error(('Unable to read ox_inventory items, QBCore items were not converted: %s'):format(oxItems))
        return
    end

    local names, weapons, weaponParts = {}, {}, {}

    for name, item in pairs(items) do
        if not oxItems[name] then
            if item.type == 'weapon' or name:find('^weapon_') then
                weapons[#weapons + 1] = name
            elseif isWeaponPart(name) then
                weaponParts[#weaponParts + 1] = name
            else
                names[#names + 1] = name
            end
        end
    end

    if #names == 0 and not verbose then return end

    table.sort(names)
    table.sort(weapons)
    table.sort(weaponParts)

    if #names > 0 then
        if not saveConverted(names, items, weapons, weaponParts) then
            lib.print.error(('Unable to save converted items to qbx_core/%s'):format(outputFile))
            return
        end

        lib.print.warn(('%d QBCore items in qbx_core/shared/items.lua are missing from ox_inventory and were written to qbx_core/%s'):format(#names, outputFile))
        lib.print.warn(('To import them, paste the entries of qbx_core/%s just before the last "}" of ox_inventory/data/items.lua, copy their images to ox_inventory/web/images and restart the server'):format(outputFile))
    else
        lib.print.info('No QBCore items need converting, ox_inventory already defines every regular item in qbx_core/shared/items.lua')
    end

    if #weapons > 0 then
        lib.print.warn(('%d QBCore weapons are not defined in ox_inventory/data/weapons.lua and must be added there by hand: %s'):format(#weapons, table.concat(weapons, ', ')))
    end

    if #weaponParts > 0 then
        lib.print.warn(('%d QBCore ammo, attachment and tint items were not converted because ox_inventory defines its own in data/weapons.lua (e.g. ammo-9, at_flashlight): %s'):format(#weaponParts, table.concat(weaponParts, ', ')))
    end
end

return {
    convertItems = convertItems,
    getQbItems = getQbItems,
}

local qbShared = require 'shared.main'

---Mirrors ox_inventory's own rule for giving an item a use action (modules/items/shared.lua)
---@param data table ox_inventory item definition
---@return boolean
local function isUseable(data)
    local client, server = data.client or {}, data.server or {}
    return data.consume ~= nil or client.status ~= nil or client.usetime ~= nil or client.export ~= nil or server.export ~= nil
end

qbShared.Items = {}
local oxItems = require '@ox_inventory.data.items'
for item, data in pairs(oxItems) do
    qbShared.Items[item] = {
        name = item,
        label = data.label,
        weight = data.weight or 0,
        type = 'item',
        image = data.client?.image or item .. '.png',
        unique = data.stack == false,
        useable = isUseable(data),
        shouldClose = data.close ~= false,
        combinable = nil,
        description = data.description or nil
    }
end
local oxWeapons = require '@ox_inventory.data.weapons'
for name, data in pairs(oxWeapons.Weapons) do
    local weapon = string.lower(name)
    qbShared.Items[weapon] = {
        name = weapon,
        label = data.label,
        weight = data.weight or 0,
        type = 'weapon',
        ammotype = data.ammoname or nil,
        image = data.client?.image or name .. '.png',
        unique = true,
        useable = false,
        shouldClose = true,
        combinable = nil,
        description = nil
    }
end
for name, data in pairs(oxWeapons.Components) do
    local component = string.lower(name)
    qbShared.Items[component] = {
        name = component,
        label = data.label,
        weight = data.weight or 0,
        type = 'component',
        image = data.client?.image or name .. '.png',
        unique = true,
        useable = false,
        shouldClose = true,
        combinable = nil,
        description = data.description
    }
end
for name, data in pairs(oxWeapons.Ammo) do
    local ammo = string.lower(name)
    qbShared.Items[ammo] = {
        name = ammo,
        label = data.label,
        weight = data.weight or 0,
        type = 'ammo',
        image = data.client?.image or name .. '.png',
        unique = true,
        useable = false,
        shouldClose = true,
        combinable = nil,
        description = data.description
    }
end

local starterItems = require 'config.shared'.starterItems
---@deprecated use starterItems in config/shared.lua
qbShared.StarterItems = {}

if type(starterItems) == 'table' then
    for i = 1, #starterItems do
        local item = starterItems[i]

        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: deprecated
        qbShared.StarterItems[item.name] = {
            amount = item.amount,
            item = item.name,
        }
    end
end

---@deprecated use lib.math.groupdigits from ox_lib
qbShared.CommaValue = lib.math.groupdigits

---@deprecated use lib.string.random from ox_lib
qbShared.RandomStr = function(length)
    if length <= 0 then return '' end
    local pattern = math.random(2) == 1 and 'a' or 'A'

    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: deprecated
    return qbShared.RandomStr(length - 1) .. lib.string.random(pattern)
end

---@deprecated use lib.string.random from ox_lib
qbShared.RandomInt = function(length)
    if length <= 0 then return '' end

    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: deprecated
    return qbShared.RandomInt(length - 1) .. lib.string.random('1')
end

qbShared.SplitStr = function(str, delimiter)
    local result = table.pack(string.strsplit(delimiter, str))
    result.n = nil
    return result
end

qbShared.Trim = function(str)

    return qbx.string.trim(str)
end

end

---@deprecated check type(value) directly
---@param value any
---@return boolean
qbShared.IsFunction = function(value)
    if type(value) == 'table' then
        return type(rawget(value, '__cfx_functionReference')) == 'string'
    end
    return type(value) == 'function'
end

return qbShared
